label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode (trials < ~25)
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (100% of mass), and almost only when the previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 99.9% of mass; never fires when the D1 reward input was 1). It is also confined to early episode: the rate is highest on trials 1-9 (6-12x lift), falls off through trials 20-30, and is zero from trial ~40 on. It never fires at D1 or D2, or on GO steps after a rewarded trial. GO & prev_reward==0 alone has recall 0.997 but precision 0.08. Adding ep_trial<25 brings precision to 0.35 with 0.98 mass recall (dev F1 0.50). Further conditions (two losses in a row, switch choice, chose_good, value, |choice|) did not raise F1. Weaker trends that I did not turn into predicates: more activity when the previous choice was a2 and in common-unrewarded cores. Inside the early window, which GO-after-loss steps fire is not well predicted by observed task variables, so precision stays incomplete. Uses only observed variables plus episode position.
